candidateDeltaAudit.method: Static, read-only audit of the checked-out source repository (git rev-parse blob comparisons between the two commits, git diff -U0/-U5 on the changed files, git grep across both commits, plus a lockfile-to-manifest specifier cross-check) against the argv, environment, evidence and artifact contracts the benchmark actually uses (tools/frontier-harness-agent/frontier_harness_best_agent/__init__.py and scripts/frontier-harness-harness.mjs). It did not build or run the CLI: every statement below is source-level, and the smoke remains the first execution evidence.
candidateDeltaAudit.interfaceContract: NO BLOCKING CHANGE. apps/cli/src/index.ts, apps/cli/src/v3-attempt-evidence.ts, apps/cli/src/thread-usage-sink.ts, apps/cli/src/v3-generation-manager.ts, apps/cli/src/v3-request-budget.ts, apps/cli/src/v3-execution-profile.ts, apps/cli/src/compact-application-contracts.ts, packages/v3-thread-store/src/usage-accounting.ts, v3/src/plan.ts, apps/cli/src/v3-provider-config.ts and apps/cli/src/v3-oauth-persistence.ts are byte-identical between the two commits (identical blob hashes). Every flag the plugin passes still exists with the same meaning and domain (--model, --model-timeout-ms, --attempt-remaining-ms, --workspace/--workspace-backend plain, --workspace-authorization unrestricted, --workspace-grant read/write/exec, --process-isolation host, --process-close-policy release, --command-policy path, --tool-exclude network, --attempt-evidence, --no-base-instructions), no flag was added, renamed or removed, and no required environment variable was added; apps/cli/src/v3-run-options.ts changes only by an import, an optional in-process `worktree?` field with no flag source, and an image-understanding helper. provider.json's accepted field set is still the same 12-key whitelist, unknown keys still fail, and the DIMCODE_HOME config.json / dimcode/auth.json paths are unchanged. The evidence JSONL shape (header, model-request, model-outcome, model-failure, terminal-snapshot, footer with prefixSha256) and the metrics read path (<storage>/v3-threads.sqlite -> thread_metrics) are unchanged; the thread-store schema rises 55/56 -> 58 and adds thread_worktrees / run_tail_withholdings / two pending_deliveries columns, none of which the read path touches. Two semantic changes are disclosed because they can be observed in a run: the model binding now rejects an empty completion (a tool-calls turn with no calls, or a stop turn with no text and no call) as failure(malformed) instead of submitting it as a completed turn, and a dim-oauth route whose model id matches /claude/ switches to the Anthropic Messages wire, where promptTokens includes cache read and write (GLM and DeepSeek routes do not match, so this run's token accounting reads the same bytes as before).
candidateDeltaAudit.promptAndContextComposition: Model-visible instruction texts change. BASE_AGENT_INSTRUCTION_TEXT (apps/cli/src/v3-prompt-composition.ts) 2,050 -> 3,232 bytes: the first line becomes 'You are best-agent...', a new Identity section appears, and the reference-code clause expands into a Markdown absolute-path/image rule. The two workspace-permission lines inside it lose the wording 'non-root' and gain executable-path/bounded-cwd wording (135 -> 126 and 153 -> 157 bytes). A new worktree instruction slot exists (a 94-byte line plus apps/cli/src/worktree-instruction.ts) but only materializes when the task runs inside a managed worktree, which the harness does not use. WORKSPACE_TOOL_ROUTING_INSTRUCTION_TEXT (apps/cli/src/product-slices/workspace-tools.ts) 814 -> 1,543 bytes, adding the spec 340 clauses ('An external program is not a Tool name...' and the bounded-cwd rule), and the same file now receives workspaceRoot, which alters path aliasing and description text. COMPACTED_CONTEXT_INSTRUCTION_TEXT is byte-identical (1,071 bytes, unchanged since the previous candidate), as are the compact fold projection's readable lines and the task-management text.
candidateDeltaAudit.modelVisibleChanges: Tool definitions change: exec cwd and args wording plus the command-shape grammar gain the cwd-relative executable form; write/mkdir gain the parents sentence; edit's oldText ceiling rises 262,144 -> 4,194,304 bytes (the editFileBytes constant itself is unchanged); process-start's cwd becomes optional (required: [argv]) and its resource-scope budget rises 4,266 -> 17,026 bytes; web_search, generate_image and image-understanding descriptions gain their envelope/budget sentences; todowrite, subagent-wait (the model-failure path now names subagent-continue first) and the workflow save/start descriptions change; every enum node gains type: "string" and several maxLength/minLength bounds are removed. No tool was added or removed. MCP keeps Ajv input validation (byte-identical constructors) but drops the per-item 262,144-byte and 2,048-byte failure ceilings in favour of one 1,048,576-byte aggregate, and the MCP prompt ceiling drops its 16,384-byte per-message limit for a 65,536-byte aggregate, so tool results can reach the model larger than before. The regenerated child-model catalog changes the subagent tool's enumerated model set (3,101 -> 3,061 entries; the image-support catalog 48 -> 50 providers). No new user-message kind can enter model input.
candidateDeltaAudit.frozenQuantities: The attempt-level money and time constants are unchanged: DEFAULT_MODEL_TIMEOUT_MS 900,000 (v3-run-options.ts), and the same expression chain providerConfig.timeoutMs ?? options.modelTimeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_MODEL_TIMEOUT_MS; v3-request-budget.ts, v3-execution-profile.ts, v3/src/plan.ts (HarnessPlan.limits), MAX_PROCESS_LIFETIME_MS 2,147,000,000, MAX_PARALLEL_TOOL_CALLS_PER_MODEL_CYCLE 4, SERVER_MAX_MODEL_CYCLES 800, COMPACT_ROUND_BOUND_MS 180,000 and the compact fold's 96,000/8,000/80,000/8,192-byte source slices are all value-identical (the fold slice was only extracted into named constants). The kernel's TERMINAL_CAUSES vocabulary is byte-identical (13 values, none added or removed) as are v3/src/kernel/{lifecycle,input,state,data}.ts and packages/v3-thread-store/src/terminal-wakes.ts, and the documented position is that the socket stall is closed only by the model deadline, with no second deadline mechanism. New: AUTO_COMPACT_FAILURE_RETRY_LIMIT = 4 bounds the wait for a non-waiting compact refusal (2,000 ms x 2^(n-1), at most 4 attempts) where the old path retried to the ceiling, and the auto-compact preflight narrows its mayStillLand set to waiting-class codes only, so a compact refusal can end a turn's wait earlier than before. The per-call ceiling this run materializes is still the frozen 1,800,000 ms (config generation.modelInvocationTimeoutMs), and the harness still passes the task's own agent budget (multiplier 1).

knownRisks.providerTransport: A provider transport failure is not retried inside the run: it costs the cell its verdict exactly as measured before. The 7-cell recheck of the previous run (38237805023) saw transport truncation in four cells even at fh_max_parallel=1, so those failures are not a run-level concurrency artifact and this run does not change any condition to avoid them.
knownRisks.ecrThrottle: Kept at fh_max_parallel=3, the width the previous two full runs used with zero ECR image-pull throttles; a recurrence would be a pre-model environment failure with no attempt and no verdict.
knownRisks.budgetExhausted: The long datacurve cells approach their official 5400s agent budget; the previous run recorded budgetExhausted 0 but two cells whose primary Run was stopped inside the candidate's own attempt-budget window. No budget is extended to make a cell scoreable.

knownRisks.noReproducibleBinary: The SEA build is not byte-reproducible, so this run's binarySha256 is its own; the receipt and the per-run candidateId are the only identity that binds the attempts to the pinned commit.
